name: GIGABYTE M27Q 27 Inch 165Hz 1440P KVM Gaming Monitor
description: GIGABYTE M27Q 27-inch QHD (2560 x 1440) SuperSpeed IPS gaming monitor. Features a blazing fast 165Hz refresh rate (overclockable to 170Hz) and a 0.5ms (MPRT) response time for ultra-smooth gameplay. Supports studio-grade VESA DisplayHDR400 and a wide 92% DCI-P3 color gamut. Equipped with a built-in KVM switch that allows you to control multiple devices (like a gaming PC and a work laptop) with one set of keyboard and mouse. Versatile connectivity options including USB Type-C, DisplayPort, and HDMI ports. Great condition, perfect upgrade for both gaming and productivity setup. Selling cheap for graduation moving sale!
name_zh: 技嘉 GIGABYTE M27Q 27英寸 2K 170Hz KVM电竞显示器
description_zh: 技嘉 GIGABYTE M27Q 27英寸 2K WQHD (2560x1440) 高刷SuperSpeed IPS专业电竞/办公显示器。拥有原生 165Hz 刷新率（可超频至 170Hz） 和 0.5ms 极速响应时间。通过 VESA DisplayHDR400 认证，拥有 92% DCI-P3 广色域。最大亮点是内置 KVM 功能，支持用一套键盘鼠标在两台设备（如游戏台式机和办公笔记本）之间一键无缝切换。接口丰富，带 Type-C（支持全功能输入）、DP 以及双 HDMI。成色好无坏点，毕业搬家低价打包诚心出！
